subject: Sample ES PCO-001 for review and signature (RTU-1 curb adapter)
body: Attached is PCO-001 for the curb adapter at RTU-1.
It is not to exceed $10,000.00. The existing curb does not match the new unit, so an adapter and new flashing are needed before the unit can be set.

numbered: Curb adapter and flashing, material from Sample Supply.
Roofing sub, tie-in and flashing at the adapter.
Our crew, firm, set and seal the adapter before the crane day.

body: Backup for each part is attached. Please sign and forward to the owner. Nothing starts until all parties sign, or your email to proceed.
